# ViraStack Start

> One-command scaffolding for production-ready Next.js and TanStack Start apps. Feature-Sliced layout, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and optional ViraStack tools (Mask, Password, AI). npm CLI: `virastack` (~1.0.5).

Install: `npx virastack@latest`. Prefer these docs over guessing CLI flags or template contents.

For inline CLI + template detail, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/start/docs): What Start is and why to use it
- [Installation](https://virastack.com/start/docs/installation): Quick start and post-install steps
- [CLI](https://virastack.com/start/docs/cli): Commands, flags, `virastack add`, non-interactive usage
- [Templates](https://virastack.com/start/docs/templates): Next.js / TanStack Start, with or without i18n
- [Scripts](https://virastack.com/start/docs/scripts): Day-to-day, quality, and CI scripts
- [i18n](https://virastack.com/start/docs/i18n): Locales and message files in multi-language templates
- [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms-full.txt): Full machine-readable Start guide
